title: tenant-slice-orchestrator-zero-ripple-redeploy
creator: Priya Patel
description: Implement a tenant-slice orchestration pattern for private (VPC) data-plane redeploys that guarantees zero user-visible ripple during runtime upgrades. This ticket covers the Terraform/IaC changes to expose slice-level controls, the operator logic for coordinated reprovision + priming, health-check evolution for stateful runtime pods (KV cache warm state), and a deterministic rollback path when priming or readiness gates fail. Goal: allow upgrades of the runtime with no request errors or cold-start regressions for active tenants while keeping operator complexity manageable and IaC reproducible.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module exposes tenant_slice_count and slice_affinity tags and a documented migration path for existing stacks
Orchestrator creates a new slice, routes 0% -> 100% traffic via progressive stitch with configurable step size, and respects priming SLOs before shifting more traffic
Synthetic priming probes (per-slice) exercise KV-prefill and warm-path generation; rollout does not advance until priming_latency < 500ms p95 and error_rate < 0.1% for 3 consecutive checks
Connection drain and sticky-session behavior maintained: in-flight requests finish on old slice; new requests route to new slice once health is green
Automatic rollback triggers within 5 minutes of priming or latency regressions with a documented retrieval of pre-upgrade state and safe evacuation of partially migrated tenants
All changes covered by Terraform plan output and integration test that validates a canary slice upgrade in a CI environment
Runbook updated and operations-approved; security review completed and audit logs captured for each slice transition
technical_notes: We treat each tenant slice as a small, versioned runtime cohort (K8s StatefulSet per slice in private deployments). The orchestrator will be an extension of the existing upgrade operator but with 'slice lifecycle' primitives: create-slice, prime-slice, stitch-traffic, observe-gates, finalize, and tear-down-old. Priming will use a prewarm job that writes and reads from the tenant-specific KV namespace to ensure the new node heatmap and KV cache contain expected hot keys. Terraform changes: add module var tenant_slice_count, slice_tags, and a resource for a slice-provisioning service account to allow operator-driven create/destroy. Health checks will add a primed=true probe that only returns healthy after prewarm success. Rollbacks will rely on snapshotting runtime state (ephemeral snapshot API) before route shift and on retaining old slice until rollback completes.
implementation_plan: Design: finalize orchestrator API and slice lifecycle events (2d)
Terraform: add tenant_slice_count var, slice IAM role, and S3-backed state locking for slice metadata (3d)
Operator: implement prime-slice hook, readiness gating, and stitch controller (5d)
Priming jobs: implement idempotent KV prefill job and synthetic traffic harness (2d)
Testing: integration test harness to simulate 50 tenants across 4 slices (3d)
Docs & runbooks: update private-deploy runbook and Terraform upgrade guide (1d)
Security review & audit: coordinate with security for role scoping and KMS access (1d)
rollout_steps: 1) Create a feature branch for terraform module changes and open RFC PR
2) Deploy module change to staging and provision an extra slice but keep it isolated
3) Operator creates slice and runs priming job against the new slice KV namespace
4) Wait for priming probes to report stable metrics (p95 < 500ms, error < 0.1%)
5) Stitch traffic at LB in 10% increments with 5-minute observation windows between steps
6) If gates satisfied, continue until 100% and mark old slice as draining
7) Keep old slice in 'standby' for 30 minutes post-complete for fast rollback window, then schedule teardown
8) Run post-upgrade validation suite (synthetic + real traffic smoke tests) and create release note entry
rollback_plan: Automatic rollback if priming_latency > 500ms p95 or error_rate > 0.5% during any observation window
Rollback action: move LB traffic back to old slice in 20% steps with immediate override option for emergency full cutback
Operator will snapshot failing slice logs and metrics and annotate the Terraform state with failed_slice_id
Restore: if new slice mutated persistent tenant metadata, use pre-upgrade state snapshot to repair; otherwise rely on sticky old slice to continue serving
Post-rollback: create an incident with RCA tags, block reattempts until root cause is addressed and a mitigation branch is merged
test_matrix: Canary upgrade with 5% traffic: validate priming + no error spikes
Concurrent upgrade: upgrade 2 slices simultaneously in staging to validate controller locks
Failure injection: network partition one priming pod, assert rollback triggers
Cold-start heavy traffic: prime with synthetic 10k qps burst and measure KV warm hit rate
Terraform drift: apply/plan after manual slice deletion and assert idempotent reconciliation
open_risks: Stateful tenant-specific KV prefill may take longer than expected for very large tenants — mitigation: partition prefill into background batches and extend observation windows
Operator bug could leak service accounts when create/destroy is interrupted — mitigation: add garbage-collection finalizers and IaC checks
Load balancer sticky session semantics differ between customer network topologies in private deployments — mitigation: add per-deployment LB adapter layer and test matrix
Terraform state compatibility: older stacks may not have slice metadata; include a one-time migration subcommand
comments: 2026-02-18 Priya Patel: Created initial ticket after postmortem of a failed rolling upgrade in customer-vpc-12. Problem modes observed: KV cold hits and 502s during rapid traffic shift.

2026-02-20 Diego Morales: Spike-tested priming job locally; warmup of KV for a 200k-key tenant took 14s for top-10% keys but full namespace prefill is long — proposing hybrid: prefill hot keys then background backfill.

2026-02-24 Alex Nguyen (SRE): Reviewed health gating thresholds. Suggested adding a short-circuit that permits low-traffic tenants to be exempt from priming if traffic < 10rps to avoid long tail delays.
2026-02-26 Security (Maya Li): Scoped service account role changes reviewed; KMS write access must be audited. Marked security_review_required=true and requested KMS policy patch.

2026-03-01 Diego Morales: Operator prime hook landed in feature branch. Running staging end-to-end now. Observed priming probe flakiness under simulated spike — increasing probe retry and adding jitter to priming job start times.
